Package dev.turboism.sdk.json

Class Json

java.lang.Object
dev.turboism.sdk.json.Json
public final class Json extends Object
Dependency-free strict JSON codec for plugin protocol and settings payloads.

The parser accepts exactly one complete JSON document. It rejects malformed UTF-8, UTF-8 byte-order marks, empty input, trailing content after the document, duplicate object keys, unpaired surrogates (literal or escaped), unescaped control characters, invalid escapes, leading zeros, non-ASCII digits, malformed exponents such as 1e+-2, and nesting deeper than 64 levels.

Decoded values use only these Java shapes:

  • Map<String, Object> (insertion-ordered LinkedHashMap) for objects
  • List<Object> for arrays
  • String, Boolean, null
  • Long for integral numbers that fit in 64 bits, BigDecimal for all other numbers

The public surface is typed by root shape: parseObject(byte[]) and parseArray(byte[]) decode object and array documents, and stringify/bytes accept Map and List roots. Top-level scalars are not part of the typed surface. Nested values still accept only the JSON-native shapes above (maps with String keys, Iterables, and Object[] arrays for collections; Byte, Short, Integer, Long, BigDecimal, Float, and Double for numbers). Non-finite floating-point numbers, unpaired surrogates, non-string map keys, and nesting deeper than 64 levels are rejected. Object members are written in map iteration order.

All failures surface as IllegalArgumentException.

    • sanitize

      public static <T> T sanitize(T value)
      Returns value — or a copy — with every unpaired surrogate in strings replaced by U+FFFD and every non-finite Float or Double replaced by null. Map keys are rewritten the same way as values. The input is never mutated; when nothing needs rewriting the same instance is returned.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the value type
      Parameters:
      value - the object or tree to sanitize
      Returns:
      the sanitized value, or value if no rewriting was needed
